## CHANNELS - Private Handle Unknown Channel

**RFC:** RFC-004

**Description:** Gère le cas où un channel privé n'existe plus sur Discord. Supprime l'ancien enregistrement et recrée un nouveau channel.

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/private-channel-unknown

**InputSchema:**
```json
{"type":"object","required":["discord_user_id","guild_id","old_channel_id"],"properties":{"discord_user_id":{"type":"string","description":"ID Discord de l'utilisateur"},"guild_id":{"type":"string","description":"ID du serveur Discord"},"old_channel_id":{"type":"string","description":"ID du channel supprimé"},"channel_type":{"type":"string","default":"support"},"metadata":{"type":"object"}}}
```

**Flow:**
1. DELETE api-backend (old channel)
2. POST chatbot-core (create Discord)
3. POST api-backend (register new)
4. Return channel info
